# Articulation joint

Query target: `ARTICULATION_JOINT`. These are static capabilities; the live session decides which objects and operations are available. See [session semantics](../data_model.md) and [write behavior](../writable.md).

Shapes describe tensor dimensions; lanes describe the tuple width, not an extra dimension. Ordering is row-major unless stated otherwise. **CPU** means host memory; **scene device** means CPU on CPU/readback scenes or CUDA on DirectGPU; **CUDA** requires CUDA. Symbolic sizes come from the live group.

| Attribute | Access | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| [jointActuationForce](#jointactuationforce) | read/write | applied actuation effort |
| [jointArmature](#jointarmature) | read/write | added rotor inertia |
| [jointDamping](#jointdamping) | read/write | drive effort per unit rate error |
| [jointDriveType](#jointdrivetype) | read/write | 0 none / 1 force / 2 accel |
| [jointDynamicFriction](#jointdynamicfriction) | read/write | break-away / sliding effort |
| [jointLimit](#jointlimit) | read/write | (low, high) motion limit |
| [jointMaxActuatorVelocity](#jointmaxactuatorvelocity) | read/write | actuator rate bound |
| [jointMaxForce](#jointmaxforce) | read/write | drive effort bound |
| [jointMaxVelocity](#jointmaxvelocity) | read/write | joint rate bound |
| [jointPosition](#jointposition) | read/write | generalized position |
| [jointPositionTarget](#jointpositiontarget) | read/write | drive position target |
| [jointProjectedForce](#jointprojectedforce) | read | inbound joint force on this axis |
| [jointSpeedEffortGradient](#jointspeedeffortgradient) | read/write | drive-envelope rate per effort |
| [jointStaticFriction](#jointstaticfriction) | read/write | break-away / sliding effort |
| [jointStiffness](#jointstiffness) | read/write | drive effort per unit position error |
| [jointVelocity](#jointvelocity) | read/write | generalized velocity |
| [jointVelocityDependentResistance](#jointvelocitydependentresistance) | read/write | envelope resistance per rate |
| [jointVelocityTarget](#jointvelocitytarget) | read/write | drive velocity target |
| [jointViscousFriction](#jointviscousfriction) | read/write | effort per unit rate |
| [physxPointer](#physxpointer) | read | Borrowed native PhysX address for this query target; no ownership transfer. |

## Conditions

### DirectGPU warmup

Device-backed DirectGPU state requires a completed first step; a write never warms the simulation automatically.

### Joint limit

Finite limits require limited axes; changing a free axis to limited requires structural authoring. Invalid conditions reject before mutation.

### Native pointer

Borrowed native address, valid only while the object remains alive. Does not confer ownership or bypass runtime synchronization. Structural changes (adding, removing or re-inserting objects, moving them between scenes, attaching or detaching shapes) through a native PhysX pointer are not recommended: after one, ovphysx reads and writes are not guaranteed to work until the stage is re-attached.
